title: Verify npm namespace and release promotion access
description: Before publication, verify ownership/access for the existing npm scopes, package/version availability and the GitHub release destination. Configure narrowly scoped publication credentials or trusted publishing separately from candidate CI. Preserve current public package identities unless a reviewed naming decision is necessary.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated read-only checks establish npm namespace authorization and GitHub destination access. Engine acceptance and complete byte-reproducibility evidence are present before separately authorized promotion; no registry publish or release creation is implied by preflight.
notes: Read-only npm whoami preflight returned ENEEDAUTH; no npm publication credential is configured for the active CLI session. Public GitHub destination is accessible. No publication attempted.

title: Complete fresh Unity bundle installation acceptance
description: Import the released embedded UPM set into a fresh external Unity project and run nonzero EditMode assembly probes through agent-unity. Existing helper discovery marks the closed temporary project open before launch; diagnose or await a supported helper fix without bypassing editor ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Real fresh-project package import and compilation pass; nonzero selected tests succeed. Verify the downloadable Unity bundle and record source revision/hashes. Preserve existing Editors and user work.
notes: Blocked evidence retained under .local/release-upm: unity status has zero instances and no Editor process targets the temporary project, but pipeline discovery says running. One bounded retry reproduced the same rejection before import.

title: Automate portable candidate reproducibility in CI
description: Build npm candidates and direct DLL/Unity bundles twice from one immutable source revision, compare every file, verify external compiler and direct DLL consumers, and retain candidate artifacts/logs without publication.
close_reason: Reproducibility command, portable consumer verification, pinned candidate CI and local byte-for-byte proof completed.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducibility command compares complete manifests, notices, locks and archives and rejects differences. Windows CI pins action/tool versions, runs source quality and portable checks, and retains evidence without a publish step.
notes: Two independent committed-source snapshots with fresh Bun/managed caches produced 64 byte-identical files, including npm/UPM archives, Unity/runtime ZIPs, notices, frozen consumer lock and manifest/checksums. Full portable packed compiler/SDK verification passed. Direct DLL host with no feeds passed RPG/MMO/skill codec roundtrips, smoke21 and lifecycle48. Four release guard tests, typechecks, generation/boundaries/provider checks, lint/format, native import inventory and 14 mise tasks pass. Candidate workflow uses pinned actions/tools and read-only permissions; remote CI has not run because nothing was pushed. Unity import and publication access remain separate open gates.

title: Add engine marketplace distribution
description: After direct GitHub installation is stable, evaluate Unity Asset Store, Fab for Unity and Unreal, and Godot ecosystem listings. Repackage the same compatible engine releases for each channel and review submission/license requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Approved listings identify supported engine/platform versions and install the same tested runtime. Marketplace publication remains separately authorized; no marketplace dependency for GitHub users.

title: Ship npm CLI for init dev and scaffolding
description: Provide npm-installed Capsule CLI commands for project initialization, starting/stopping the UI development server, connecting an engine and scaffolding addons/components/features. Engine plugins can invoke shared implementations. Resolve compatible tooling from the engine release manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Document supported commands and test them outside the source checkout. Init preserves existing files; dev reports connection and compilation failures; scaffolds use public exports and exact dependencies. No requirement to install engine adapters through the CLI.

title: Design Godot and Unreal plugin bundles
description: Later adapters should install as Godot addons/capsule and Unreal Plugins/Capsule, with native libraries for their supported platforms and an editor setup entry point. Reuse the React compiler, development connection and compatibility contract; do not assume a C# runtime in Unreal.
acceptance_criteria: Record engine/version/platform support and native ABI requirements before implementation. Each adapter has a self-contained GitHub release bundle and automated fresh-project and live-reload acceptance.

title: Add Unity plugin setup and React project connection
description: Provide Capsule > Setup in the Unity plugin. Validate dependencies, native resource compatibility, input, TMP and restart requirements. Create or connect an external React UI project using the shared CLI API. Preserve dirty scenes and existing settings; no automatic project mutation on import.
acceptance_criteria: Repeatable setup works in fresh and existing projects. Demonstrate a running Unity host plus UI server with live TSX/theme reload, last-good preservation on invalid edits and working controls after replacement.

title: Provide plugin-first project setup and CLI workflows
description: Make an engine plugin the entry point for Capsule. Begin with Unity setup and an external React UI project; retain npm CLI workflows for initialization, development server and scaffolding. Future adapters share the development protocol without requiring C# in every engine.

title: Build npm candidates and a Unity release bundle
description: Build npm-ready JS/TS candidates, a self-contained GitHub Unity bundle of eight UPM packages, and a direct managed/native runtime ZIP for standalone hosts. Remove NuGet packaging; use DLL references in isolated verification.
close_reason: Plugin-first candidate packaging and portable external consumers verified; engine import remains explicitly tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Packed public exports, compiler and SDK resolve outside workspaces. Unity ZIP contains all eight embedded UPM packages with stable GUIDs/resources/notices and one revision. Portable runtime ZIP contains seven direct managed DLLs, the pinned JSON dependency and native/resources/notices. No nupkg generation. Manifest and archive integrities are complete.
notes: Eight npm candidates, eight UPM archives, embedded Unity ZIP and direct managed/native runtime ZIP implemented. NuGet tooling removed. Frozen external npm consumer passes 16 feature identities, public codegen, SDK compilation and invalid/repaired addon publication; generated SDK matches embedded bytes. Direct DLL host with empty cache/no feeds passes real native checks and lifecycle. Fixed CRLF translation in ZIP creation and pinned a nonzero archive epoch; focused reproducibility, dependency-rejection, lint/format and import inventory checks pass. Full two-snapshot proof and engine import remain in the verification parent.

title: Verify release reproducibility and automation
description: Verify npm candidates and GitHub engine bundles as a compatible reproducible set, with independent consumer checks and CI. npm publication, GitHub release promotion and marketplace submission are explicit separate actions.
acceptance_criteria: Two clean builds reproduce npm and GitHub bundle bytes. Verification rejects corruption, floating/local dependencies and incompatible sets. Fresh npm compiler/SDK and direct DLL native lifecycle checks pass without package feeds or source project references. CI retains candidate assets without publishing. Fresh Unity import is separately required before promotion.
notes: Portable candidate implementation and reproducibility automation complete in closed children. Two source snapshots yielded 64 identical files; packed JS/compiler/SDK, direct DLL codec roundtrips and native smoke21/lifecycle48 pass. Remaining child capsule-14 requires real fresh Unity import after helper running-state mismatch is resolved. No engine acceptance claimed; no push or publication. Resume at capsule-14 after supported tooling recovery.

title: Build a reproducible release candidate
description: Deliver plugin-first installation: npm distributes JS/TS libraries and CLI tooling; GitHub Releases distributes engine-native bundles with their managed/native libraries, licenses and compatibility manifest. No Capsule NuGet packages. Publication and marketplace submission remain separate actions.
acceptance_criteria: One immutable source identity coordinates npm candidates and self-contained engine bundles. Exact dependencies, hashes, tools, ABI and notices are recorded. Fresh packed consumers and repeated clean builds verify the candidate. Unity is the first adapter; Godot and Unreal adapters and marketplace distribution are later work.
notes: npm candidates and GitHub Unity/direct-runtime bundles are implemented and reproducible. NuGet packaging removed. Engine-plugin setup and CLI roadmap is tracked independently. Remaining release gates: fresh Unity consumer acceptance and npm namespace/access verification; active CLI preflight returned ENEEDAUTH. Public GitHub repository read access and push permission confirmed. No remote CI, push, tag or publication performed.

title: Package portable managed release libraries
description: Add coordinated NuGet packaging and native/resource notices, deterministic build settings and isolated packed consumers; verify all portable managed dependency locks.
acceptance_criteria: Seven managed libraries produce versioned deterministic NuGet candidates. Exact internal dependency closure and runtime/resource payloads are explicit. External local-feed consumers restore and run without project references or source paths. Existing dependency guards and locked restores pass.
notes: Historical managed packaging step completed with isolated native proof. Distribution decision subsequently changed: NuGet packaging removed; current release builder ships direct managed DLLs and native/resources in GitHub ZIPs. The follow-on bundle implementation supersedes this packaging format.

title: Extract reusable feature contracts and examples
description: Establish RPG, MMO and skill-system source packages, neutral inventory example, canonical native contract packages and generators. Keep game-specific providers, catalogs and integrations outside this repository.
acceptance_criteria: Public names, versions, descriptors, fingerprints and generated C# remain unchanged. Independent typechecks, mock/provider tests, generation drift and dependency checks pass. Native libraries and neutral providers compile/run without an engine or game checkout. Inventory remains example-only. Fresh consumer resolves all declared dependencies. No private consumer identifiers in code, records, history or commit messages.
notes: Reusable RPG/MMO/skill packages and example inventory are independent. Canonical generated C# belongs to three UPM Runtime packages; standalone projects compile the same files and preserved GUIDs. Public names/versions, 14 production and two example feature identities, five descriptor JSONs and generated C# remain stable. Ten typechecks, 44 feature tests, three Node checks, native providers, frozen external source consumer and clean exported checkout checks pass. Import verifier covers 175 files, 91 GUIDs and eight packages. No consumer identifiers or source history imported. Evidence: docs/verification/game-features.json; guide: docs/game-features.md. New Unity packages have structural/standalone verification, not Editor or rendered acceptance.

title: Ship reusable game feature libraries
description: Provide engine-independent RPG, MMO and skill-system contracts, mocks, generators, native interfaces and neutral examples with independent development tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Public contract identities and generated wire formats remain stable. Standalone and Unity package consumers use canonical native contracts. Neutral provider tests and an independent workspace validate declared dependencies. Repository tooling and tracker remain self-contained.
notes: Both scoped tasks completed: pinned mise tooling and independent Bees tracking, reusable feature definitions/mocks/generators/native contracts and neutral inventory example. Portable provider and fresh checkout validation pass. Release packaging, feeds and rendered engine integration are not part of this source-library milestone.

title: Configure mise and repository task tracking
description: Pin Bun, Node and Bees in repository mise configuration, add portable runner tasks, initialize the capsule tracker and document contributor commands.
acceptance_criteria: mise tasks validate succeeds; pinned tools and Bees resolve in this checkout. Tracker uses capsule identifiers and excludes SQLite runtime state from Git. Frozen dependency installation and representative mise tasks run. No private consumer names or machine paths in tracked configuration or records.
notes: Pinned Bun 1.3.6, Node 25.6.1 and Bees 0.4.0. Initialized capsule-prefix tracker and ignored local SQLite state. Nine mise task definitions validate; frozen install, six workspace typechecks and JavaScript quality pass through mise. Contributor commands and tracker/commit conventions documented.
